content.text: {"what_it_is":{"claims":[{"text":"Special Programs - MDA is a research and development budget line run by the Missile Defense Agency (MDA), funded through the Research, Development, Test and Evaluation, Defense-Wide account.","citation":{"fact_id":"ff838c19a86b3f59"}},{"text":"The program is reported in accordance with Title 10, United States Code, Section 119 in the annual Special Access Program Budget Justification submission to Congress — meaning it is a classified special-access program.","citation":{"fact_id":"d33c062f553ef4c5"}},{"text":"It is also reported under Title 10, U.S. Code, Section 119(a)(1) in the Special Access Program Annual Report to Congress.","citation":{"fact_id":"a7e6e7fa60135530"}},{"text":"The program's budget detail is organized under a single project, MD27, titled 'Special Programs.'","citation":{"fact_id":"31480e52d64a8c42"}},{"text":"Across all prior years, the program had accumulated $4,190.494 million (about $4.19 billion) in funding.","citation":{"fact_id":"3c8a8edafe46e1c9"}}]},"why_it_matters":{"claims":[{"text":"The program spent $551.028 million (recorded as $551,028 thousand) in actual funding in fiscal year 2024.","citation":{"fact_id":"ff838c19a86b3f59"}},{"text":"For fiscal year 2025, Congress enacted $495.57 million (recorded as $495,570 thousand).","citation":{"fact_id":"ea0b5dee9a518cd0"}},{"text":"The full fiscal year 2026 request totals $821.43 million (recorded as $821,430 thousand).","citation":{"fact_id":"4d1d59c7767d68bd"}},{"text":"That fiscal year 2026 total combines a base discretionary request of $498.63 million (recorded as $498,630 thousand) with an additional reconciliation request of $322.8 million (recorded as $322,800 thousand).","citation":{"fact_id":"c5666bada354a3bd"}},{"text":"The reconciliation portion of the fiscal year 2026 request is $322,800 thousand, roughly $322.8 million.","citation":{"fact_id":"93d95c1f72850fc0"}},{"text":"The change from FY2025 to FY2026 amounts to an increase of $325.86 million (recorded as $325,860 thousand).","citation":{"fact_id":"f267900a6b254055"}}]},"players":{"claims":[{"text":"The program is managed by the Missile Defense Agency (MDA), and its budget detail is captured entirely within a single organizational component.","citation":{"fact_id":"4d1d59c7767d68bd"}}]},"recent_developments":{"claims":[{"text":"An automated budget-tracking event flagged that Special Programs - MDA increased 66% from FY2025 to FY2026, a jump of $325,860 thousand from $495,570 thousand to $821,430 thousand.","citation":{"fact_id":"f267900a6b254055"}}]}}
